title: Unique coefficients in the localized base for a triangular monic quotient
statement: Let k and K be fields with a k-algebra structure, d,m natural numbers, x:Fin d→K, b:Fin m→K, h∈R=k[X₀,…,X_{d−1}], and p_i monic polynomials over k[X₀,…,X_{d+i}] with natDegree e_i. Let y:Fin(d+1+m)→K assign x to its first d variables, h(x)⁻¹ to variable d, and b_i to variable d+1+i. Suppose the triangular equations all evaluate to zero. Set D=Localization.Away h. For any k-algebra homomorphism phi:D→K agreeing with evaluation at x on R, there is a k-linear equivalence nf from the quotient by the triangular equations to the functions from bounded exponent tuples to D. For every polynomial q, its evaluation at y is the sum over exponent tuples a of phi(nf([q])(a)) times ∏ᵢ b_i^(a_i). No algebraic independence or field generated by x is used.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07BV, first assertion, triangular minimal polynomials and denominator clearing; Tag 08JZ, localization presentation. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JZ because the local literature checkout is absent.

proof.text: Construct the canonical coefficient homomorphism psi:D→Q using the localization universal property: the quotient relation hT-1 exhibits the image of h as a unit.
Define the k-linear synthesis map as the sum of localized coefficients times bounded monomials. Apply reconstruction_bijective to obtain bijectivity and take the inverse linear equivalence nf.

Descend evaluation to Q using the ideal span property and hzero. Localization extensionality gives ev composed with psi equals phi, since hyx and hphi establish agreement on the base ring. Apply ev to the identity synthesis(nf([q]))=[q], distribute ev over the sum and products, and use hyb on the quotient variables. This proves the required evaluation formula. hyt is redundant: the inverse value is forced by the localization relation.

from.place: Triangular field model in the approximation argument: successive monic division after denominator clearing, corresponding to normal-form proof steps 1–3.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModel_localized_normal_form
    (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → K) (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → K)
    (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (y : Fin (d + 1 + m) → K) (e : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic) (he : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = e i)
    (hyx : ∀ j : Fin d, y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ = x j)
    (hyt : y ⟨d, by omega⟩ = (MvPolynomial.aeval x h)⁻¹)
    (hyb : ∀ i : Fin m, y ⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ = b i)
    (hzero : ∀ q ∈ triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p,
      MvPolynomial.aeval y q = 0)
    (phi : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k] K)
    (hphi : ∀ r : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k,
      phi (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away h) r) = MvPolynomial.aeval x r) :
    ∃ nf : (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)) ≃ₗ[k]
        (((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)) → Localization.Away h),
      ∀ q : MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k,
        MvPolynomial.aeval y q =
          ∑ a : ((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)),
            phi (nf (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q) a) * (∏ i, b i ^ (a i).val)
